mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animal) AS animalTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animal WHERE is_approved = 0) AS animalPending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rescue_order) AS rescueTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rescue_order WHERE order_status = '待处理') AS rescuePending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adoption WHERE status = '待审核') AS adoptionPending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS userTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_record) AS feedTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_point) AS pointTotal

SELECT a.*, CAST(a.is_approved AS UNSIGNED) AS approval_number, u.nickname AS creator_name FROM animal a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.create_user = u.user_id WHERE a.is_approved = #{approved} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.animal_id DESC

SELECT ad.*, a.animal_name, a.type AS animal_type, ap.nickname AS applicant_name, rv.nickname AS reviewer_name FROM adoption ad LEFT JOIN animal a ON ad.animal_id = a.animal_id LEFT JOIN `user` ap ON ad.applicant_id = ap.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` rv ON ad.review_user_id = rv.user_id WHERE ad.status = #{status} ORDER BY ad.apply_time DESC, ad.id DESC
SELECT fp.*, u.nickname AS updater_name FROM feed_point fp LEFT JOIN `user` u ON fp.last_update_user = u.user_id ORDER BY fp.point_id
SELECT user_id, username, nickname, phone, role, love_points, create_time FROM `user` ORDER BY user_id

SELECT fr.*, u.nickname AS user_name, fp.point_name FROM feed_record fr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON fr.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN feed_point fp ON fr.point_id = fp.point_id ORDER BY fr.feed_time DESC, fr.record_id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT user_id, username, nickname, phone FROM `user` WHERE role IN ('admin', 'volunteer') ORDER BY user_id
